title: Lattice Timing Track (LTT) 1.0, canonical encoding
description: GENERATED from docs/src/lib/ltt/types.ts by tools/build-ltt-schema.js — do not edit. Rebuild: npm run ltt-schema:build. Spec: engineering/ltt.md.

Word.description: One word of a caption: what the viewer reads, what the voice says, and when.

display.description: The glyph group shown in the caption (e.g. "$4.2M"). The highlight unit.

spoken.description: The spoken expansion timing is computed on (e.g. "four point two million dollars").

charOffset.description: Index into the source text where `display` begins (best-effort forward scan).

weight.description: Emphasis weight, 1 = ordinary. ABSENT for an ordinary word — an unweighted deck therefore serializes exactly as it did before emphasis existed, so no golden or manifest moves.

Cue.description: One caption line: a sentence, in the words it is shown and spoken in.

display.description: The caption line as shown (the display words joined).

endsParagraph.description: True when a PARAGRAPH / topic boundary (a blank line) follows this cue — so the gap before the next cue is the deeper `PARAGRAPH_PAUSE_MS` beat, not the sentence pause. The clocked player reads this to widen the inter-clip breath (read-aloud.ts). Absent/false for an ordinary sentence break.

weight.description: The cue's emphasis weight — the MAX over its words, absent when ordinary. This is what buys the extra breath AFTER the cue (`interCueGapMs`), and max is the right reducer because a sentence is as important as the most important thing in it; averaging would let a long sentence dilute its own key phrase into silence. Every consumer computing the inter-cue gap MUST read it from here so the estimate and the clocked player stay in step.

CaptionTrack.description: A timed caption track: the cues of one stretch of narration, laid end to end from zero.

durationMs.description: Total estimated duration (end of the last cue), ms.

LttHash.description: A content hash, written `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

LttDeckPace.description: The deck's `pace:` register (lib/core/resolve-pace.mjs): how long a new slide holds.

LttBasis.description: How far to trust a segment's numbers: Cadenza's text-only `estimate`, or re-timed to a real clip (`measured`).

LttAfter.description: The wait a player honors before a tour stretch starts. Never a time: how long it lasts is unknown until a run is recorded. `awaitUser` waits for the viewer, `until` for a condition in the page, `act` for an asynchronous action to finish.

LttSource.description: What the file was built from, as a whole.

id.description: The deck's file name or the tour's id — whatever its producer uses to find it again.

LttViewport.description: The screen a tour was recorded on.

LttInputs.description: Every input that changes timing, file-wide. A segment's `hash` covers all of them.

engine.description: Content hash of the timing engine's build — NOT its package version, which has never moved.

acronyms.description: Hash of the deck's acronym registry.

viewport.description: Tours only: the screen a recorded run's timing depended on.

motion.description: Tours only: the motion tier a recorded run played at.

stagePace.description: Tours only: the stage's `pace` multiplier a recorded run played at.

speed.description: Pace multiplier passed to the voice (1 = natural).

LttAudio.description: AUDIO layer (Suono). A reader that does not know it plays silently on the estimate.

src.description: The clip: a path relative to the file, or a `data:` URI.

clip.description: Content hash of the clip bytes.

LttAction.description: ACTIONS layer (Vetrina). An action is anchored to a WORD, never to a time.

cue.description: Index of the cue in this segment's track.

word.description: Index of the word in that cue.

match.description: The word the author named, normalized (case-folded, edge punctuation stripped). `validateLtt` fails when the word at `{cue, word}` no longer normalizes to it.

verb.description: What the cursor does (`click`, `type`, …) — Vetrina's verb.

target.description: The CSS selector the verb acts on.

arrive.description: When the cursor arrives: `on-word` lands it on the word.

LttSlideSegment.description: A narrated deck slide: its arrival hold, then its track.

hash.description: Hash of this slide's narration text plus the file's `inputs`.

holdMs.description: The hold on arrival. 0 on the first slide.

tailMs.description: The breath the player holds after the slide's LAST cue, before it advances. The track ends at the end of its last cue, so this is the one part of a slide's length the track cannot say. A slide lasts `holdMs + track.durationMs + tailMs`.

LttHoldSegment.description: A deck slide with no narration: its arrival hold and nothing else.

LttStretchSegment.description: In a tour, the run between two waits.

after.description: The wait before this stretch. Absent: it follows the previous segment at once.

waitedMs.description: How long the `after` wait took in a recorded run. Required on every waited stretch of a seekable file, because a seekable file must know every segment's length.

hash.description: Hash of this stretch's narration text, the storyboard steps it spans, and the file's `inputs`.

LttSlideAt.description: Where a deck segment sits: its 1-based slide number.

LttBeatsAt.description: Where a tour stretch sits: the first and last storyboard beat it spans.

Ltt.description: A Lattice Timing Track, in its canonical encoding (`*.ltt.json`).

seekable.description: True when every segment's length is known, so the segments lay end to end on one timeline.
